title: [Taking Requests] I'll compose free custom music!

posts.author: really
posts.body:
Edit 9/27/25
Due to a busy schedule, I haven't been able to take requests much anymore. So, I'm temporarily considering this thread closed. Please don't hesitate to get in touch though! I will just likely not be able to fill any requests in the near future.
I hope to open it back up soon!
---
Hello!
Who Am I?
I go by "really", and I've been using RPG Maker (Mostly VX Ace) for some years. I've been a fan of RPGs even longer.
I've been writing music for a few years now. Up till now I've mostly just composed to learn, and to make music I liked. But, I'd eventually like to break into composing/scoring if I can. Especially in gaming. I think a game's music, sound, and atmosphere really elevate the experience from decent to memorable, or even great (especially in RPGs). I'd love to have a part in helping games reach their full potential in that way.
With that in mind, I'd like to gain some experience writing for games.
The Request Thread
I'm looking to take some requests to write music for RPG maker games!
Hopefully, I can learn and improve my skills, while you can get free custom music for your game!
I'm comfortable making most styles of BGM, or any type of music for that matter. If I haven't already explored a style/mood that you're looking for, I'd love the chance to try it.
Spoiler:
Details For Requesters
I'm available for single tracks or even multiple if you can wait long enough. Personally, I love when a game soundtrack maintains a consistent "feeling" throughout, especially when they use motifs and reoccurring themes/ideas from beginning to end. With that in mind, I see the value in providing more than just one song. I'd just have to have enough time for the desired amount of music.
I'd like to post any fulfilled requests (songs) in this thread, as well as to my soundcloud (Just as a standalone album like the rest of my stuff, unless you'd specifically like me to mention your game).
If I get multiple requests, I will do my best to fulfill them, but I may have to decline some. I work during the week, so at this point I think I could handle about a track per one or two weeks, depending on complexity.
I'm happy to format tracks however you'd like. I'd love to get some practice with dynamic tracks that change according to certain parameters. See, for example, the modern Fire Emblem battle themes where the intensity of the music changes based on whether you are in battle. I've always felt things like this really made a game feel special.
I can also do some sound design, provided I have time. You can find some SFX examples in some of the songs on my soundcloud.
Thank you so much for reading / considering. Feel free to ask me anything; I'd like to be as accommodating as possible. I also love to discuss music, so even if you don't have a request, I'm always down to talk game music or get suggestions on my music.
Thanks,
really
